details.question: Does augmenting tetravalent T with a trajectory field (ascending/steady/declining derived from quality-trend deltas) predict the recommendation field better than truth_value alone? Specifically, does ascending-T -> promote, steady-T -> maintain, declining-T -> investigate match the recorded recommendations on the existing 11 evolution entries above chance baseline?
details.rationale: The original Proposal D (refine U with Subjective Logic) targets the wrong gap. Real data shows U->investigate is 1:1 deterministic (3 of 3); the heterogeneity lives in T-states. This follow-up cycle, running after quality-trend has 4 weeks of trajectory data, can compare the trajectory-augmented T classification against actual recommendations. Hold Proposal D at PDCA plan phase pending this finding.
